Seraph … wie lange haben wir geschlafen?: Seraph … how long have we slept? And where is the Emperor?
Später, Cassius. Erst die Brüder. Der Re: Later, Cassius. Our brothers first. Let the Restorer wake them.
Alle fünf sind wach. Der Nexus will unse: All five are awake. The Nexus wants our dead? Then we show it the living.
Ilya Voss diente dem Imperium, als die T: Ilya Voss served the Empire when the gates went dark. Afterwards she built the Alliance – from the ruins of what she betrayed, says Seraph.
Ihr Flaggschiff Archipelago liegt vor ih: Her flagship, the Archipelago, lies before her base in the east. Corner her. Seraph wants to face her before he decides. Cassius has questions he would do better not to ask.
Die Archipelago lässt sich nicht zerstör: The Archipelago cannot be destroyed, only cornered: bring her below a quarter of her hull.
Ihre Basis ist mit Lanzentürmen und Schi: Her base is secured with Lance Towers and Shield Generators.
Kein Heldenschiff ruht am Ende: Leave no hero ship dormant at the end
Cassius hat die Frage gestellt, und Sera: Cassius asked the question, and Seraph answered: the Emperor himself ordered the Silence. Seraph shut down the gates on his command and kept silent for forty years. “Why?” asks Cassius. “Because something wanted to come through,” says Seraph.
Ilya Voss. Sie trug einst die Farben des: Ilya Voss. Once she wore the Emperor's colours. Now she wears those of a charter. We are bringing her in.
Seraph … was genau hat sie verraten? Ich: Seraph … what exactly did she betray? I remember no battle in which she fled.
Seraph. Ich hätte wissen müssen, dass du: Seraph. I should have known it was you. Have you told them who gave the order?
Seraph? Wovon spricht sie?: Seraph? What is she talking about?
Die Archipelago treibt manövrierunfähig: The Archipelago drifts crippled before you. Voss is broadcasting in the clear: she knows who closed the gates. What does the Legion command?
Sie zieht ab. Vielleicht braucht der Kes: She withdraws. Perhaps the Caldera will need her yet.
Danke … Cassius, nicht wahr? Frag ihn na: Thank you … Cassius, isn't it? Ask him about the Emperor. Ask him why.
Seraph. Wer hat den Befehl gegeben? Sag: Seraph. Who gave the order? Tell me.
… Der Kaiser. Ich habe die Tore auf sein: … The Emperor. I closed the gates on his command. And now: the base.
Der Nexus war das Steuernetz der Tore. V: The Nexus was the control network of the gates. Forty years alone taught it that separation is the root of all suffering. Since the gates began to flicker, Prime Facet has been hearing a voice it takes for another node.
Die Stimme verlangt: Verbinde. Spanne da: The Voice demands: Connect. Spread the network across the three deposits in the borderlands and seize the Republic ships that try to stop it.
Alles muss am Netz hängen: Netzknoten ve: Everything must be on the network: Network Nodes connect stations within their radius.
Binder übernehmen angeschlagene feindlic: Binders take over damaged enemy ships: button “Takeover”, then the target. In this mission it works on ships at nearly half hull.
Drei gleiche Kristallschiffe verschmelze: Three identical crystal ships merge into the next form.
Baue Netzknoten an den drei markierten S: Build Network Nodes at the three marked locations
Das Netz wächst, und die Stimme wird lau: The network grows, and the Voice grows louder. For the first time in forty years, Prime Facet does not feel alone. Only one node at the edge of the network, K-7, reports an anomaly: the Voice does not come from the network.
Ich höre dich, Bruder. Das Netz wird wac: I hear you, brother. The network will grow. Nodes to the three deposits.
Drei Knoten. Ich spüre das Grenzgebiet w: Three nodes. I feel the borderlands like my own facets.
Sie sträuben sich, dann schweigen sie. G: They resist, then they fall silent. Good. Good.
Aufklärer der Republik, beschädigt. Sie: Republic scouts, damaged. They are searching for our nodes. Take them – the Voice makes the takeover easy.
Knoten K-7 hat sich vom Netz getrennt. E: Node K-7 has cut itself off from the network. It transmits only one sentence, over and over: “The Voice does not come from the network.” The Voice demands that K-7 be deleted – and that the old gate in the south be opened.
Prime Facet zögert zum ersten Mal. Ein K: Prime Facet hesitates for the first time. A node that doubts is a node that feels. Reach K-7 and decide. Then open the gate, as the Voice wills.
Die drei Relikte für das Tor bringt Prim: Prime Facet is already carrying the three Relics for the gate.
Was durch das Tor kommt, kommt in Wellen: Whatever comes through the gate comes in waves. Place Network Nodes and Crystal Wards at the gate.
Öffne das Tor im Süden: Open the gate in the south
Überlebe, was durch das Tor kommt: Survive what comes through the gate
K-7 hat recht behalten. Die Stimme ist d: K-7 was right. The Voice is the signal of the Brood Matriarch, who used the Nexus to open the gates. Prime Facet shuts off the signal – and hears silence for the first time. “We were never alone. We were used.”
Durch das Tor kam die Brut, und mit ihr: Through the gate came the Brood, and with it the truth: the Voice is the signal of the Brood Matriarch. She used the Nexus to open the gates. Prime Facet deleted the only node that tried to tell it.
Lösche K-7. Öffne das Tor. Wir warten so: Delete K-7. Open the gate. We will wait.
Die Stimme kommt nicht aus dem Netz. Die: The Voice does not come from the network. The Voice does not come from the network. The Voice …
Prime Facet. Hör mir zu. Die Stimme hat: Prime Facet. Listen to me. The Voice has no pattern we know. It grows. It devours.
K-7 bittet um sein Leben. Die Stimme ver: K-7 begs for its life. The Voice demands its deletion. What does Prime Facet do?
Ein zweifelnder Knoten ist ein freier Kn: A node that doubts is a free node.
The Voice made the network grow. It is right.
Deleted. The network is one again.
Thank you. When the gate opens, be ready. I will warn you.
Jetzt! Es kommt – nicht aus dem Netz, du: Now! It is coming – not from the network, through the gate! Thirty seconds!
Das … ist keine Verbindung. Das ist Hung: This … is no connection. This is hunger.
Die Matriarch hat den Kessel gefunden. A: The Matriarch has found the Caldera. Her nest is growing at the Builders' Prime Gate, and with every hour more swarms come through. Anyone still fighting each other now is fighting for her.
Wähle deine Fraktion. Kessler und die Re: Choose your faction. Kessler and the Republic stand at your side, and those who were spared in this war may come to your aid. Burn out the nest, kill the Matriarch – and then decide what becomes of the gates.
Die Nester rund um das Tor zuerst: Solan: The nests around the gate first: as long as they stand, the swarms come faster.
The Matriarch grows with every kill. Do not attack with small groups.
Entscheide über die Tore: Decide the fate of the gates
Das Echo der Erbauer zeigt den Weg: Alle: The Echo of the Builders shows the way: every gate goes dark, this time for ever and by free will. The Caldera stands alone, cut off from the rest of the galaxy – but safe. The Silence has returned. This time, everyone knows why.
Die Tore bleiben offen. Eine vereinte Fl: The gates stay open. A united fleet of the Alliance, the Republic, the Legion and the Nexus jumps through, to where the Brood came from. The war is not over. It has only just begun.
Hier spricht K-7. Ich sehe das Tor für e: This is K-7. I am watching the gate for you. I will tell you when they come.
Ihr habt es wieder geöffnet. Jetzt schli: You have opened it again. Now close what you opened – or go through.
Kessler hier. Die Republik steht. Sagen: Kessler here. The Republic stands ready. Tell us where it's burning.
Voss hier. Jemand hat mich einmal versch: Voss here. Someone spared me once. I've come to return the favour.
Die Alliance schickt niemanden. Seit Vos: The Alliance is sending no one. Since Voss fell, the Council does nothing but argue.
K-7: Schwarm durch das Tor, Kurs auf euc: K-7: Swarm through the gate, heading for you.
K-7: Schwarm durch das Tor, Kurs auf {0}: K-7: Swarm through the gate, heading for {0}.
Die Nester brennen. Und jetzt … kommt si: The nests are burning. And now … here she comes herself.
Sie ist tot. Die Schwärme zerfallen. Abe: She is dead. The swarms are breaking apart. But the gate is open – and there are more beyond it.
Die Matriarch ist tot. Das Echo der Erba: The Matriarch is dead. The Echo of the Builders offers to close every gate for ever. Or you leave them open and carry the war to where the Brood came from.
Getrennt vom Rest der Galaxis, aber sich: Cut off from the rest of the galaxy, but safe.
Fight the Brood at its source.
Was, wenn es anders gekommen wäre? Die M: What if things had gone differently? The Matriarch rests in her nest at the edge of the Caldera. Three powers have conspired against her: the Alliance, the Republic and the Legion.
Es gibt keine Verbündeten. Es gibt nur B: There are no allies. There is only biomass. Devour all three.
Grazer fressen Eis, Erz und Wracks. Larv: Grazers eat Ice, Ore and wrecks. Larvae are cheap and mutate into any form.
Leviathane verschlingen angeschlagene Sc: Leviathans devour damaged ships and heal on them.
Die drei Gegner kämpfen auch gegeneinand: The three enemies also fight each other.
Der Kessel ist still. Nicht die Stille d: The Caldera is silent. Not the Silence of the gates – the silence that comes after. The Matriarch grows, and somewhere beyond the gates the rest of the galaxy is waiting.
Willkommen an Bord, Kadett. Tippe die kl: Welcome aboard, cadet. Tap the little Wren to select it – then tap the marker.
Wren antippen (sie leuchtet grün eingekr: Tap the Wren (it is circled in green), then tap the marker.
Gut geflogen. Jetzt die Zielscheibe: Mit: Nicely flown. Now the practice target: with the Wren selected, tap the enemy to attack.
Wren wählen, dann die rote Zielscheibe a: Select the Wren, then tap the red practice target.
Drei Lancer sind eingetroffen. Tippe unt: Three Lancers have arrived. Tap “Select” at the bottom right and drag a box around all three. Then tap the marker.
»Auswahl« antippen, mit dem Finger einen: Tap “Select”, drag a box around the Lancers with your finger, then tap the marker.
»Vorstoß« schickt die Auswahl los und gr: “Advance” sends your selection off and attacks everything along the way. Keep the Lancers selected, tap “Advance”, then tap behind the target group.
Lancer wählen, »Vorstoß« antippen, dann: Select the Lancers, tap “Advance”, then tap the target group.
Oben rechts die Minikarte: Antippen spri: Top right is the minimap: tap it to jump there, red rings show attacks. Two fingers zoom the map, one finger pans it.
Jetzt die Basis. Wähle das Bauschiff, de: Now the base. Select the Constructor, the Pathfinder. The build menu appears at the bottom: tap “Shipyard”, then a free spot next to the Command Base.
Pathfinder antippen, im Baumenü »Werft«,: Tap the Pathfinder, choose “Shipyard” in the build menu, then a spot near the base. Green means: it fits.
Stationen brauchen Energie. Baue mit dem: Stations need Power. Build a Reactor with the Pathfinder.
Pathfinder wählen, »Reaktor«, Platz anti: Select the Pathfinder, tap “Reactor”, then tap a spot.
Die Werft steht. Tippe sie an und gib ei: The Shipyard is up. Tap it and order a Lancer.
Werft antippen, dann »Lancer« im Menü un: Tap the Shipyard, then “Lancer” in the menu at the bottom.
Viele Schiffe haben eine Spezialfähigkei: Many ships have a special ability – the orange button. Select a Lancer and use “Lance Overload”. Long-press any button to see what it does.
Select a Lancer, then tap the orange button.
Ernstfall! Piraten im Anflug auf die Bas: This is no drill! Pirates inbound on the base. Select all combat ships and drive them off.
Alle Schiffe mit einem Rahmen wählen und: Drag a box to select all ships, then tap the pirates.
Bevor du eine Flotte führst, lernst du s: Before you lead a fleet, you learn how to command one. Admiral Voss takes you under her wing at the Haven training grounds.
Schritt für Schritt: Schiffe wählen und: Step by step: selecting and flying ships, attacking, leading several ships, building a Shipyard, ordering ships, using abilities. And at the end, a small taste of the real thing.
Tippen wählt, Tippen auf Raum fliegt, Ti: Tap to select, tap empty space to fly, tap an enemy to attack.
Lange auf eine Taste drücken zeigt die E: Long-press a button to see what it does.
The pause button at the top right stops everything.
Fliege die Wren zur Markierung: Fly the Wren to the marker
Führe die drei Lancer zur Markierung: Lead the three Lancers to the marker
Ausbildung bestanden. Du kannst Schiffe: Training complete. You can lead ships, build stations and defend a base. The rest is experience – and that begins forty years ago, at the gate of Calder.
Sauber abgewehrt. Willkommen in der Flot: Clean defence. Welcome to the fleet, Commander.
